test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

“Vidushi, the doctor has advised me to avoid sugar,” said Prabha.

options.text: Prabha told Vidushi that the doctor had advised her to avoid sugar.
Prabha said to Vidushi that the doctor was advising her to avoid sugar.
Prabha told Vidushi that the doctor advised her to avoid sugar.
Prabha told Vidushi that the doctor will be advising her to avoid sugar.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. ‘****Prabha told Vidushi that the doctor had advised her to avoid sugar.’**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Direct Speech**. 
 
• As per the given question we have to change it into **Indirect Speech.**
 
• The process of this transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The conjunction **'that' will be added** and **comma and inverted commas will be removed.**
 
• In the Indirect speech **'said' will be changed into ‘told’** because reporting verb has an object, ‘Vidushi’.
 
• **'me'** will be changed into** 'her'.**
 
• Here, **‘has advised’ is in the present perfect tense** and **will be changed into past perfect i.e., ‘****had advised’.**
 
 
 
• ​So, according to the above steps, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:**__ *Prabha told Vidushi that the doctor had advised her to avoid sugar.*
